scope: Independent-reference fitness follow-up for the four frozen Nordic gap components only.

tested_reference.name: Natural Earth 10m Physical Vectors: land and lakes
tested_reference.retrieved_at: 2026-10-05 (as recorded in the immutable issue manifest)
tested_reference.scale: 1:10,000,000 cartographic scale; “10m” is not 10-meter positional resolution

limits: The source commit is dated 2022-06-02, later than the Norway 2013 and Sweden 2017 boundary vintages; it is not a historical land/water snapshot for those years.
The lake layer is generalized and incomplete for rivers, small water, seasonal water, and ice.

method.engine: GEOS/Shapely result already retained by PR #1233; this follow-up summarizes those exact result geometries and does not rerun or rewrite them.
method.operation: Exact planar intersections and differences in OGC:CRS84; no transform, snap, buffer, simplify, make-valid, coordinate normalization, or area cutoff.
method.units: square degrees only; not geodesic/physical area

results.interpretation: Exact retained overlay classifies the candidate as contained by the generalized land geometry and disjoint from mapped lakes; this does not prove historical dry land or absence of unmapped water/ice.

precision_and_registration.input_crs: RFC 7946 GeoJSON coordinates use WGS 84 longitude-latitude; the Natural Earth source declares OGC:CRS84. No reprojection was performed.
precision_and_registration.interpretation: Decimal digits are serialized numeric precision, not measurement accuracy. The retained Natural Earth record has no target-specific positional-accuracy declaration. The exact overlay uses no buffer or tolerance and provides no sub-grid registration or positional-error estimate.
precision_and_registration.official_product_accuracy_not_transferre: Kartverket product documentation reports a broad 0.3–20 m accuracy range for its Administrative Units Norway product; Lantmäteriet states positional uncertainty varies by object and method. Neither figure is assigned to these candidates without retrieving and binding the exact relevant product/version/features.

conclusion: The only executed independent physical/water comparison is the pinned Natural Earth 2022-06-02 1:10m-scale context. It depicts each complete candidate as land and none as a mapped lake. This is consistent with a coarse modern land interpretation, but does not establish historical dry land, eliminate unrepresented streams/ponds/ice, identify the source of the gaps, establish an international boundary, or authorize assignment. Official higher-detail Norway and Sweden products are documented as promising follow-up references; their geometry and matching historical vintages remain uninspected.
